title: Pokemon TCG Sinistcha ex RR 009/066 Japanese Card Crimson Haze - U.S. Seller
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Sinistcha ex in stunning full art. With a card number of 009/066, this Japanese Crimson Haze card is a must-have for any serious collector. The card is from the 2023 series and is a Stage 2 plant type creature. 

Made from high-quality paper and with a holographic finish, this card is perfect for display or for use in competitive play. The card is a standard size and is suitable for ages 6 and up. Don't miss out on the chance to add this amazing card to your collection.
